description: All 18 throughput-mode runs, 500000 measured requests each: frozen 25cec55 reference, frozen 7d29382, then the predeclared return to the original 25cec55 binaries. Each matrix includes snapshot off/on with three repetitions. Actual executable copies and generated data are omitted; every other raw file is retained. Original paths and driver Git metadata are provenance, not runtime version. These records predate subsequent throughput-path optimizations; observed variation does not establish its cause.
